name: dependabot-triager
title_zh: 只评不批的Dependabot PR分流员，三档结论
tagline_zh: 每天堆积的依赖更新PR，它逐条读上游源码改动后给出Merge/先审/别合三档结论，附高/中/低置信度。
tagline_en: For every open Dependabot PR, it reads the upstream diff, then posts one comment: Merge, Review first, or Don't.
desc_en: Assesses an open Dependabot pull request and emits a recommendation (Merge / Review before merging / Do not merge) plus confidence (High / Medium / Low) with concise prose grounded in upstream source changes. Advisory only: it posts a single comment and never merges, approves, or labels. Designed to run as a scheduled reconciler that comments exactly once per PR state and re-comments only when the
why_zh: 结论扎根于上游源码变更而非依赖元数据，能识别版本跳跃中的真实风险；状态机确保同一PR状态只评论一次。
why_en: Verdicts are grounded in the actual upstream source diff, not just version numbers — so it catches risky jumps. A state machine.
limit_zh: 只处理Dependabot开的PR，且需能访问上游仓库源码；不合并、不批准、不打标签，仅输出建议。
limit_en: Only for Dependabot PRs with reachable upstream source. It never merges, approves, or labels — advisory comment only. Skips silently if upstream is.
title_en: Dependabot PR triager: 3 verdicts with confidence, no merge
